title: project-rules upsert and DELETE are not operator-guarded
body:
## Summary
POST (upsert) and DELETE /api/project-rules write the canon that enters prompts with no requireOperator, unlike the four bulk actions beside them.

## Description
src/app/api/project-rules/route.ts:58 parses a rule from any POST; req.json() ignores Content-Type, so a text/plain cross-site form reaches it with no preflight, and the rule enters every prompt in its scope. DELETE at :88 needs a preflight but also has no guard. Guarding them would make the editor (src/components/layout-lab/canonStore.ts:53,60) answer 401 when POF_OPERATOR_TOKEN is set, because no client sends the token, so it needs a decision on token mode rather than a one-line add.

## Flow
- cross-site text/plain POST with a rule body -> validateRuleDraft -> upsertRule -> rule in prompts
- fix: requireOperator on POST and DELETE, plus a browser credential path for token mode

## Expected impact
Closes a CSRF write into prompt canon. Could break the canon editor on a token-configured deployment.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - canon writes are same-origin only
Before: not measured: no cross-site upsert test exists
After: cross-site upsert -> 403, editor still saves in both token modes
Method: simulation - read the route and the guard; the token-mode UI path needs a run
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: policy-tighten
instrument: route test with a cross-site Origin plus a token-mode run of canonStore upsert

title: GET /api/search?rebuild=1 mutates the index
body:
## Summary
A GET deletes and rebuilds the whole search index, against the rule in api-auth that GET handlers do not mutate.

## Description
src/app/api/search/route.ts:11 calls rebuildSearchIndex, which runs DELETE FROM search_index (src/lib/search-index.ts:51). src/lib/api-auth.ts:31 justifies leaving GETs unguarded because they neither mutate nor spawn. An image tag can trigger it. The index is derived, so the harm is load and a window of empty results.

## Flow
- cross-site img src=/api/search?rebuild=1 -> index cleared and rebuilt
- fix: POST /api/search with requireOperator, migrate src/components/layout/GlobalSearchPanel/useGlobalSearchPanel.ts:123

## Expected impact
Removes a state change from GET; the panel keeps rebuilding through the new verb.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - GET is read-only across project-ops
Before: 1 mutating GET in 13 routes
After: 0 mutating GETs
Method: simulation - walked the route and its one caller
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: route test that GET rebuild is refused and POST rebuilds, plus the panel hook test

title: moduleId is an unchecked cast on session-log, session-analytics and error-memory
body:
## Summary
Three write routes cast moduleId to SubModuleId with no membership check, while feature-matrix and import refuse an unknown id.

## Description
src/app/api/session-log/route.ts, src/app/api/session-analytics/route.ts and src/app/api/error-memory/route.ts only require a string now. feature-matrix guards against SUB_MODULE_IDS (4b238f9d). src/lib/event-bus-bridge.ts:264 types moduleId as plain string, so non-module hosts may log legitimately; refusing blind would lose real telemetry.

## Flow
- POST moduleId=not-a-module -> row stored under a module no view reads
- fix: enumerate emitted ids, then guard against SUB_MODULE_IDS or an explicit extended set

## Expected impact
Rollups stop collecting unreadable rows. Could drop logging from a host outside the enum.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - closed enum at the boundary
Before: guard on 0 of 3 routes
After: guard on 3 of 3 with 0 legitimate emitters refused
Method: simulation - the emitter set was not enumerated
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: policy-tighten
instrument: count distinct module_id values in session_log and session_analytics against SUB_MODULE_IDS on a real DB copy

title: workflow-dag route has no consumer
body:
## Summary
/api/workflow-dag is called by nothing in src or scripts; its GET also answers an unknown action with the template list.

## Description
A grep for workflow-dag over src and scripts, excluding the route and tests, returns 0 files. The library behind it stays live through src/stores/taskDAGStore.ts. src/app/api/workflow-dag/route.ts:37 falls through to the templates on any unknown action, where every sibling answers 400.

## Flow
- grep -rn workflow-dag src scripts -> only the route itself
- decide: delete the route (and its context-map entry), or wire it and refuse unknown actions

## Expected impact
One fewer untested API surface. External pof-mcp use must be ruled out first.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no unreachable routes
Before: 1 route with 0 in-tree consumers
After: 0
Method: probe - grep over src and scripts
Result: better
Gate: direction
instrument: owner call: keep as a public API or delete

title: promptVariantId is sent to session-analytics and dropped
body:
## Summary
useSessionAnalytics posts promptVariantId on every run outcome; the route and the table have no field for it.

## Description
src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:137 passes promptVariantId through src/hooks/useSessionAnalytics.ts into POST /api/session-analytics. src/app/api/session-analytics/route.ts builds recordSession from a fixed field list that omits it, and src/lib/session-analytics-db.ts has no column. Prompt-evolution fitness attributes through other paths (src/lib/cli-task-handlers.ts:136), so this may be a stale wire field or a missing per-variant rollup.

## Flow
- run a variant task -> outcome POST carries promptVariantId -> value discarded
- decide: drop it from the client, or add a column via migration and record it

## Expected impact
Either removes a misleading wire field or enables per-variant session rollups. A column needs a migration.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no field sent and discarded
Before: 1 field sent on every outcome, stored 0 times
After: field stored or no longer sent
Method: probe - grep across route, db and hook
Result: better
Gate: contract
instrument: read prompt-evolution fitness to see whether any reader needs a per-session variant

title: Deletes and touches of an unknown id answer success
body:
## Summary
project-rules DELETE and recent-projects touch/remove report success when no row matched, the same defect fixed on telemetry resolve.

## Description
src/lib/project-rules-db.ts:344 returns void and src/app/api/project-rules/route.ts:92 answers { id }. src/app/api/recent-projects/route.ts touch and remove answer touched/removed true on zero changes. Telemetry resolve now answers 404 (98b22682). canonStore.remove ignores the answer, so the UI needs no change.

## Flow
- DELETE ?id=nope -> 200 { id: nope }
- fix: return changes > 0 from the db call and answer 404

## Expected impact
A stale-id caller learns the write did nothing. A double-delete would now read 404.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - success means a row changed
Before: 3 handlers answer success on 0 rows
After: 0 handlers
Method: simulation - walked the handlers; no test run
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: route tests for an unknown id on each of the 3 handlers

title: Two telemetry scans in one millisecond fail on the snapshot primary key
body:
## Summary
Snapshot ids are snap-Date.now() into a plain INSERT on a TEXT PRIMARY KEY, so a same-millisecond scan answers 500.

## Description
src/app/api/telemetry/route.ts builds the id from Date.now(); src/lib/telemetry-db.ts:84 is a plain INSERT, and src/lib/db.ts:472 declares id TEXT PRIMARY KEY. Reachable by a double click or two tabs.

## Flow
- two POST action=scan in one ms -> UNIQUE constraint -> 500
- fix: randomUUID suffix

## Expected impact
A rare spurious 500 disappears. No reader parses the id.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - concurrent scans both land
Before: not measured
After: two scans under a frozen clock both 200
Method: simulation - walked insert and schema; clock-frozen test not written
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: route test with Date.now mocked to a constant, two scans

title: session_log reads tie-break on a one-second created_at
body:
## Summary
Both session-log reads order by created_at alone, which has one-second resolution, so a started/completed pair in one second can come back in either order.

## Description
src/lib/session-log-db.ts getSessionLog and getModuleSessionLog ORDER BY created_at DESC; the column defaults to datetime(now) (src/lib/db.ts:402). The autoincrement id gives a stable order for free.

## Flow
- log started and completed within one second -> GET order is unspecified
- fix: ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

## Expected impact
Session history reads in true order. No behaviour change otherwise.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - deterministic list order
Before: not measured
After: same-second rows return newest id first
Method: simulation - read the queries and the column default
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: db test inserting two rows with one created_at
